|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Let the Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-98-Let_The_Wookiee_Win-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Players Committee card image and the release-sheet slip show the original text (see [[Let the Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Let the Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>: “USED: Reveal the top 3 cards of Reserve Deck; place one in hand, and the others on bottom of Used Pile (in any order). STARTING: If your starting location was a non-[Special Edition] location, ▼ an [Immune to Alter] Effect and any number of <> sites with < 3 total [Light Side Force]. Place this Interrupt in hand.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-98-Let_The_Wookiee_Win.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-letthewookieewin-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 24) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed “deploy from Reserve Deck an always [Immune to Alter] Effect and two <> sites” instead of “▼ an [Immune to Alter] Effect and any number of <> sites”<ref name="cl-1261_97-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “USED: Reveal the top 3 cards of Reserve Deck; place one in hand, and the others on bottom of Used Pile (in any order). STARTING: If your starting location was a non-[Special Edition] location, deploy from Reserve Deck an always [Immune to Alter] Effect and two <> sites with < 3 total [Light Side Force]. Place this Interrupt in hand.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-98-Let_The_Wookiee_Win-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
